description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): the upper-tail incomplete-gamma path on a geometric z ladder from 0.26 to 702 (30 runs, ratio 1.31318; part 1 of 3), each run 1,024 consecutive doubles z upward from a full-mantissa z0. Feeds the erfc kernel a z that is not fl(x*x) of any stored x: comparing B with C (stored x = SQRT(z)) and with D = EXP(-z) separates the exp factor from the rational in x. A = z, B = CHISQ.DIST.RT(2*z,1), C = ERFC.PRECISE(SQRT(z)), D = EXP(-z), E = SQRT(z).
